```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(palmerpenguins)

penguins <- penguins
```

# Penguin Plots

## Mass & Bill by Island

```{r, warning=FALSE}
mass_by_island <- ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = island, y = body_mass_g)) +
  geom_boxplot() 

ggplotly(mass_by_island)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
bill_by_island <- ggplot(penguins, aes(island, bill_length_mm)) +
  geom_boxplot() 

ggplotly(bill_by_island)
```

## Flipper & Bill Lengths {.tabset}

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#| title: Flipper Length by Mass
flipper_by_mass <- ggplot(penguins, aes(body_mass_g, flipper_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point()

ggplotly(flipper_by_mass)
```

```{r}
#| title: Bill Length by Mass
bill_by_mass <- ggplot(penguins, aes(body_mass_g, bill_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point()

ggplotly(bill_by_mass)
```

# Data Table

This dataset describes 344 individual penguins and comes from the `palmerpenguins` package. These three species of penguins live on three different islands in the Palmer Archipelago.

```{r}
penguins <- penguins |> 
  select(-c(year)) 

knitr::kable(penguins) 
```
